home.share_cta: Did your club do something good?
home.share_cta_text: Send it in two minutes. A moderator checks it and it appears here.

activity.empty: No activities match. Try another club or theme.
activity.video_note: Plays here from YouTube, without YouTube cookies.

events.subscribe_title: Get every district event in your phone calendar
events.subscribe_text: Subscribe once and new events, changes and cancellations appear in your calendar by themselves.
events.subscribe_note: Google Calendar checks for changes a few times a day, so a new event can take up to a day to appear.

celebrations.note: Shown only for members who agreed, with day and month only.

directory.intro: Find a fellow Rotarian by profession and place. Only members who agreed are listed.

directory.sample_contact: Sample entry – contact buttons are switched off

people.search: Search by name, team, committee, role or club

footer.scam: The district will never ask for money over WhatsApp. If someone does, it is not us.
footer.about: The website of the clubs of Rotary District 3110. Content is sent by clubs and checked by district moderators.
footer.guide: How to post a good activity
footer.public_service: Add a public service your club runs

club.missing: Is something missing? Update your club's profile
club.update_profile: Update this club's links, meeting details, projects or services

campaigns.title: District campaigns
campaigns.intro: District-wide drives and how much our clubs have done for each, from reports approved by district moderators.
campaigns.note: Running total of reports approved by district moderators.
campaigns.how_text: Use the activity form, choose this campaign and enter your count. Count only what your own club did.

bulletin.title: This week in District 3110
bulletin.quiet: A quiet week – no new activities or events.
bulletin.how_title: How to get your club in next week's bulletin
bulletin.how_text: Send your activities and events through the forms. A moderator checks each one; approved items appear in the next bulletin.
bulletin.official: Official district messages come only from the district's official numbers and pages.
bulletin.archive_intro: Every Sunday the website puts together "This week in District 3110" from approved activities and events.

clubs.empty: No club matches. Try another name, city or day.

services.title: Services you can use
services.intro: Blood banks, eye care, dialysis, clinics, libraries and more, run or supported by the Rotary clubs of District 3110. Each phone number is the facility's own.
services.add: Does your club run a facility the public can use? Add it

cities.title: Rotary in your city
cities.intro: Find the Rotary clubs, events, service activities and facilities in each city and town of District 3110.

contact.title: Contact the district
contact.intro: Need help from a Rotary club, want to volunteer, or represent a company that wants to partner on a project? Write to the district office here.
contact.privacy: Your name and reply details are seen only by the district office and are never shown on the website.
contact.soon: The contact form will be available soon.
contact.open: Open the form in a new tab

news.title: In the news
news.intro: Service activities of our clubs that newspapers and news websites reported. We link to the news item; we do not copy it.

years.title: Each Rotary year in review
years.intro: What the clubs of District 3110 did in each Rotary year (1 July to 30 June), from activities approved by district moderators.
